links.outcome: Moderate-to-severe AKI incidence, nephrotoxic drug use, hypotension, ICU stay before vs after AI CDS implementation
links.effect: Moderate-to-severe AKI 9/99 (9.1%) post vs 12/103 (11.7%) pre; lower nephrotoxic drug use and hypotensive episodes; uncontrolled design, causality not established.
links.quote: During the postimplementation period, lower rates of moderate-to-severe AKI (9/99, 9.1% vs 12/103, 11.7%), nephrotoxic drug administration, and hypotensive episodes among patients with AKI were observed compared with the preimplementation period.

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world clinical implementation and workflow integration of an AI-based clinical decision support system (U-Care Renal Platform) for AKI risk prediction in the ICU, comparing outcomes before and after deployment.
